title: Chemical Effect Of Current
definition: The chemical effect of electric current refers to the chemical changes, notably electrolysis and ion migration, produced when an electric current is passed through a conducting liquid (electrolyte).
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (General Science - Physics/Chemistry overlap: electroplating, Faraday's laws, conductivity of liquids) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Industrial applications, green hydrogen generation, battery technologies).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Chemical Effect Of Current.
Evaluate spatial distribution, industrial applications, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
